name: racecar-straight
$comment: Flat out from the top speed of the reference (design/reference.py: the motor at its power limit against drag, rolling resistance and tyre slip) for 10 s, then the accelerator released and the brake pedal at 50 %: regenerative braking on the rear motor within its torque and power limits, the friction brakes for the rest, against the 1-D longitudinal model.

options.text: At the top speed the 260 kW balance the drag. At 10 s the brake pedal goes down: the motor **regenerates** up to its torque and power limits, the friction brakes do the rest.

cards.title: Motor R: torque and its limit (N m)
